testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a panel layout while switching active documents: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:159:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a panel layout while switching active documents ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` are open in that order ✔ And Model Browser is docked on the left and Appearance Browser and Material Browser share a right dock as tabs ✔ And `docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active ✔ When the user switches to PartOne ✔ Then the left Model Browser and right tabbed browsers remain in place ✔ And the active document changes in the viewport ✔ When the user returns to `docking-visible-solid-current.opd` ✔ Then the left Model Browser and right tabbed browsers remain available
